title: How Amazon Really Makes Money (It's Not the Shop)
description:
Amazon sold $716.9 billion of goods and services in 2025, but most of its profit did not come from the online shop. In this file we open the money machine behind Amazon: the garage in Bellevue, the 1997 IPO and the one-cent first profit, the marketplace and Fulfillment by Amazon, Prime, the fees sellers pay, AWS (the secret profit machine), the ad business, and the $220 billion AI bet, with the latest numbers.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Amazon.com Q3 2026 results (Form 8-K, October 2026); Amazon.com Q4 and full year 2025 results; HISTORY.com (Amazon is founded); Britannica Money; Wikipedia (History of Amazon); Fortune (Inside Amazon Prime); Marketplace Pulse (Amazon GMV 2025; Amazon takes a 50% cut of sellers' revenue); Modern Retail (2025 shareholder letter).

All figures are rounded. Marketplace figures are independent estimates. Forecasts are company guidance. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
